object.attr: analysis: review Q65. Answered on 2026-11-11, to confirm: parent documents merge like links (MELLON-VER-SRS-316), so a parent one side removed doesn't come back when both sides changed the list. Replaces MELLON-VER-SRS-321 for that case.
object.description: When one side of a merge removed a parent document and the other side left the parent document declared, Mellon shall remove the parent document.
